description: Presidential Secretariat - The Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40)
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal order issued under the Public Security Ordinance (Chapter 40), calling out armed forces for public order maintenance. It constitutes a regulatory action based on existing legislation rather than being about government personnel changes, structural reorganization, or any of the other specialized categories. The content fits Legal/Regulatory (Type 5) as it involves the implementation of statutory powers and regulatory measures for public security.
